overview: Store booked date ranges per listing; reserve with an exclusion constraint on overlapping ranges (Postgres) inside a transaction.
limitations: The exclusion-calendar approach directly models single-unit listings. Multi-room hotels need per-room calendars or the inventory-table approach.

estimation.result: Range rows are compact for sparse single-unit calendars.
estimation.implication: Multi-room inventory needs separate unit allocation or inventory-table design; one exclusion range cannot model an entire hotel room count.

entityDetails.purpose: Exclusive date-range allocation for a single-unit listing.
accessPatterns: Insert a non-overlapping stay; expire or confirm an existing hold.
constraints: EXCLUDE overlapping active ranges for the same listing. Expired holds must be transitioned out of the active constraint; an index predicate cannot depend on now().
relationships: reservation_id links an exclusive stay range to Reservation and its expiry/confirmation lifecycle.

entityDetails.purpose: A guest booking and its payment lifecycle.
accessPatterns: Create a temporary hold; confirm or expire by reservation ID.
constraints: Idempotency key prevents duplicate reservations; payment failure releases capacity in the same state transition.
relationships: Own the inventory increments or CalendarBlock ranges until confirmation or expiry.

apiDetails.rationale: Search availability is a hint; authoritative availability is checked again at reservation time.
A payment callback confirms an existing hold with idempotency; never trust a stale search result.

steps.title: Guests → LB → Search Service → Listings index
steps.explanation: Find single-unit listings matching dates and filters; do not treat search as authoritative.

steps.title: Guests → LB → Reservation Service → Booking calendar DB
steps.explanation: Insert the half-open stay range under an active-hold exclusion constraint. Overlap is a 409.

steps.title: Reservation Service → Payments
steps.explanation: Authorize payment and conditionally confirm the still-valid range hold.

steps.title: Booking calendar DB → CDC stream → Index updater → Listings index
steps.explanation: Update derived search availability after commit.

failureCases.scenario: Search shows availability that has just been booked
failureCases.handling: Return 409 at reservation, suggest another listing/date, and do not charge an unconfirmed reservation. Index updates may lag the authoritative calendar.

alternatives: Use listing-day inventory for multiple interchangeable rooms. Use exclusion-constrained date ranges for single-unit homes or individually assigned rooms; one range per hotel cannot represent a room count.
